name: codefyerp-data-validation
description: CodefyERP Data Validation System for Egyptian Business Operations

scripts.build: npm run build:css && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist', {recursive:true}); const fse = require('fs-extra'); fse.copySync('./Statics', './dist/Statics'); fse.copySync('./Temp', './dist/Temp'); fse.copySync('./README.md', './dist/README.md'); fse.copySync('./vercel.json', './dist/vercel.json'); const apiFiles = ['validate.js', 'download-cleaned.js', 'excel-analyzer.js', 'serverless-api.js', 'excel-analyzer-express.js']; apiFiles.forEach(f => fse.copySync('./api/' + f, './dist/api/' + f));"

author: CodefyERP Team
